biography.value:
懼噬體是所有創自邪穢巫術的恐怖之物裏最邪惡、最墮落的一種。它是其受害者的眼、口與液化身體胡亂混合的產物。這些受害者因身體被摧毀而陷入瘋狂，然後再被懼噬體吸收同化，而它們持續喋喋不休的瘋狂又迫使其進一步吞噬所觸碰到的一切東西。

    變形蟲形態Amoeboid Form。懼噬體是一堆無定形的嘴與眼，它可以像泥怪一樣向前挪動，或是用幾張嘴咬緊地面再將自己臃腫的身軀推向後方。雖然移動得很慢，但它可以輕易的通過水麪、泥沼和流沙。

    瘋狂之嘴Mouths of Madness。懼噬體感知到獵物時身上諸多的嘴巴便開始咕噥和喋喋不休，每張嘴發出各種不同的聲音：深沉或尖銳，哀鳴或嚎叫，還有各種痛苦或狂喜的叫喊。這種不諧的雜音可以壓制聽者的感官，使大多數人驚恐地逃竄。剩下的人只能陷入瘋狂或麻痹的站定，死盯着這個可怕的生物等待它慢慢將自己吞噬。

    吞噬一切All-Consuming。懼噬體不由自主的吞沒自己能觸及的所有東西，淹沒所有被它恐懼咆哮怔住的受害者，這堆七嘴八舌在啃噬吞嚥活肉時卻又霎時間一起陷入沉默。這怪物可以將接觸到的石頭液化，以阻礙那些抵受住囈語並試圖逃跑的生物。

    懼噬體所過之處有如風捲殘雲。而受害者身體的每一絲骨肉都被吞噬乾淨後，他曾經的嘴與眼便浮現在懼噬體的表面，並加入這怪物的囈語和下一次吞食盛宴。

Of all the terrors created by foul sorcery, gibbering mouthers are among the most wicked and depraved. This creature is the composite eyes, mouths, and liquefied matter of its former victims. Driven to insanity by the destruction of their bodies and absorption into the mouther, those victims gibber incoherent madness, forced to consume everything in reach.

Amoeboid Form. The gibbering mouther's body is an amorphous mass of mouths and eyes that propels itself by oozing forward, fastening several mouths to the ground and pulling its bulk behind. Though it moves slowly, it swims through water, mud, and quicksand with ease.

Mouths of Madness. When a gibbering mouther senses prey, its mouths begin to murmur and chatter, each with a different voice: deep or shrill, wailing or ululating, crying out in agony or ecstasy. This cacophonous gibbering overcomes the senses of any creature that hears it, causing most to flee in terror. Others are overcome with madness or stand &Reference[condition=paralyzed], fixated on the horrific creature as it oozes forward to consume them.

All-Consuming. Driven to devour any creature it can reach, a gibbering mouther flows over victims transfixed by its mad ranting, its multitudinous voices temporarily silenced as it gnaws and swallows living flesh. The monster liquefies stone with which it comes into contact, hindering creatures that overcome its gibbering and attempt to flee.

A gibbering mouther leaves nothing of its prey behind. However, even as the last of a victim's body is consumed, its eyes and mouth boil to the surface, ready to join the chorus of tormented gibbering that welcomes the monster's next meal.

description.value:
懼噬體發動一次啃咬攻擊，如果條件允許則再使用一次致盲唾沫。

The gibbering mouther makes one bite attack and, if it can, uses its Blinding Spittle.

近戰武器攻擊：命中[[/r 1d20+2]]{+2}，觸及5尺，單一生物。命中：17（[[/damage 5d6 type=piercing]]）點傷害。如果該目標爲中型或更小體型，則它必須進行一次[[/save ability=str dc=10]]的豁免，豁免失敗則應擊&Reference[condition=prone]{倒地}。如果該生物被這次傷害殺死，則它將被懼噬體吸收同化。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+2]]{+2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 ([[/damage 5d6 type=piercing]]) damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a [[/save ability=str dc=10]] saving throw or be knocked &Reference[condition=prone]. If the target is killed by this damage, it is absorbed into the mouther.

噬體向身邊15尺內它能看見的一點吐出一團化學液。命中時的衝擊力使液團爆發出一片炫目的閃光。閃光處周邊5尺內的每個生物必須進行一次[[/save ability=dex dc=13]]的豁免，豁免失敗者將陷入&Reference[condition=blinded]{目盲}，直至該懼噬體下一回合結束時終止。

The mouther spits a chemical glob at a point it can see within 15 feet of it. The glob explodes in a blinding flash of light on impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the flash must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex dc=13]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=blinded] until the end of the mouther's next turn.

懼噬體周邊10尺半徑的地面成爲麪糰狀的&Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{困難地形}。在該區域內開始其回合的每個生物都必須進行一次[[/save ability=str dc=10]]的豁免，豁免失敗者其速度將降至0，直至其下一回合開始時結束。

The ground in a 10-foot radius around the mouther is doughlike &Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{difficult terrain}. Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a [[/save ability=str dc=10]] saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

懼噬體看到任何未處於&Reference[condition=incapacitated]{失能}狀態的生物時便開始語無倫次的喋喋不休。任何可以聽到懼噬體囈語的生物，在懼噬體周邊20尺內開始其自己回合時，必須進行一次[[/save ability=wis dc=10]]的豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物直至其下一回合開始前都無法執行反應，並擲一次[[/r d8]]以決定接下來自己會怎麼做。骰值爲1至4時，該生物什麼都不用做。骰值爲5至6時，該生物將無法執行任何動作或附贈動作，並花費自己所有的移動力向一個隨機方向直線移動。骰值爲7至8時，該生物在身邊觸及範圍內隨機指定一個生物並對其發動一次近戰攻擊，如果沒有合適的攻擊目標則什麼都不用做。

The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't &Reference[condition=incapacitated]. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther and can hear the gibbering must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=10]] saving throw. On a failure, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a [[/r d8]] to determine what it does during its turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.
